verdict.rationale: Cline explicitly supports bringing your own API keys from providers like OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, etc., and markets itself as not locking users into an account/platform or pricing model, allowing self-hosting/provider switching. missing for 10: no explicit documentation of an 'account login' alternative flow being fully optional (e.g., no mention of skipping any Cline account signup step), and no independent/hands-on confirmation of API-key-only auth.
